tracks.name: Mobility Resort Motegi
tracks.notes: モビリティリゾートもてぎ (Tochigi). Formerly Twin Ring Motegi (Honda Mobilityland rename effective 2022-03-01). ~4.801 km; hosts MFJ All Japan / JRR and Japanese MotoGP. Site: https://www.mr-motegi.jp

tracks.name: Suzuka Circuit

tracks.name: Sportland SUGO
tracks.notes: Murata, Miyagi. 3.704 km; MFJ All Japan / JRR superbike round.

tracks.name: Tsukuba Circuit
tracks.notes: Tsukuba, Ibaraki. ~2.07 km club circuit; All-Japan support rounds (J-GP3, JP-SPORT in 2026). Id corrected from copy-paste `sepang-international-circuit-jp`.
